title: Big, but lacking quality control
text:
Big, but lacking quality control. At our house, it is hard to have too many gnomes, or too many pumpkin decorations. This item covers both.

The pumpkin is an odd knit fabric. The black face parts are glued on rather oddly. I was trying to get the "nose" off, because it looks VERY odd, but could not do it.

The gnome itself is also cute, but lacking quality. Ours needs me to sit down with a glue gun and do some major cosmetic surgery. Lots of loose ribbon, fabric and such. One arm is hanging loose with just a dot of glue on it. Still cute, just lacking quality consistency.

I'll like it better after I do some work on it, but it is a cute decoration.
